title: Delay (Time Lag)
equation: Perceived Effect = Actual Effect ÷ Time Delay
hook: Month three looks like month one. That's exactly when most people quit.
statement: Cause and effect can be months apart.
explainer: Content, referrals, relationships pay off late. Judge them weekly and you'll quit winners.
sop: Estimate its Time Delay in weeks.
Track the work, not the results.
equation_example: Actual Effect 8 ÷ Time Delay 12 weeks = 0.67. It's working. It just doesn't feel like it.
question: Write down what you're about to quit too early.
closing_statement: Judge the trajectory, not the week.
